journey.name: tablet layout
journey.description: On a tablet in landscape, the profile QR code, the home suggestion cards and the transfer intro art keep phone-like sizes (the intros put the art beside the text) and leave their buttons on screen. Precondition: the Pixel_Tablet AVD (2560x1600 px, 320 dpi) in landscape, an onboarded dev wallet with a Pubky profile, the home suggestion cards not dismissed, and dev mode on so `bitkit://screen/` deep links open. Android 16+ ignores the portrait lock on screens 600 dp and wider for apps targeting SDK 36, so Bitkit runs in landscape there. The intro art carries no tag; check it in a screenshot. Android only: the iOS app is iPhone-only and renders at iPhone size on iPad.

actions.action: Run `adb shell cmd window user-rotation lock 0` and verify `adb shell wm size` reports 2560x1600
Tap the drawer button (tag "HeaderMenu") and then the Profile item (tag "DrawerProfile")
Verify the QR code (tag "ProfileQRCode") is square and at most 800 px wide
Verify the edit, copy and share buttons (tags "ProfileEdit", "ProfileCopy", "ProfileShare") are fully on screen without scrolling
Rotate to portrait with `adb shell cmd window user-rotation lock 1` and verify the QR code and the three buttons are on screen
Run `adb shell cmd window user-rotation lock 0` and press the device back button
Swipe up on the home screen to the widgets page
Verify every suggestion card (tags starting with "Suggestion-") is fully visible in a single row above the Send and Receive bar
Run `adb shell am start -W -a android.intent.action.VIEW -d "bitkit://screen/transfer-intro" to.bitkit.dev`
Take a screenshot and verify the lightning art sits left of the "Spending balance" headline without overlapping it, and the "TransferIntro-button" button is visible and no wider than the text column
Run `adb shell am start -W -a android.intent.action.VIEW -d "bitkit://screen/spending-intro" to.bitkit.dev`
Take a screenshot and verify the coin art sits left of the "Transfer to spending" headline without overlapping it, and the "SpendingIntro-button" button is visible and no wider than the text column
Run `adb shell wm size 1280x800` and `adb shell wm density 213` to emulate an 8-inch tablet in landscape
Tap the drawer button (tag "HeaderMenu") and swipe up inside the drawer; verify Settings (tag "DrawerSettings") and App Status (tag "DrawerAppStatus") come fully into view
Open Profile (tag "DrawerProfile") on a profile with an avatar image and verify a QR scanner reads the code (tag "ProfileQRCode") with the avatar over it
Run `adb shell wm size reset` and `adb shell wm density reset`
